MP High Court Shields Couple from Social Boycott Over Same-Gotra Marriage

The Madhya Pradesh High Court has intervened to protect a couple facing an alleged social boycott. The boycott is reportedly due to their marriage within the same gotra. The court's action comes after the couple approached it seeking relief from the ostracization, which has reportedly lasted for 11 years.
